purpose: To facilitate the manner and procedure of transferring shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF) Authority.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within a period of thirty days of such shares becoming due to be transferred to the Fund.
steps: Inform the shareholder at their latest available address three months before the due date of transfer.
Publish a notice in a leading English and regional newspaper with wide circulation.
Obtain Board authorization for the Company Secretary or another person to sign necessary documents.
Follow the procedure for transmission of shares when transferring shares to the Fund.
Credit the shares to the DEMAT Account of the Authority within thirty days of them becoming due for transfer.
checklist: Check if the beneficial owner has encashed any dividend warrant or had a dividend amount credited to their bank account during the last seven years.
Verify if there is a specific order of Court or Tribunal.
Ensure the Board has authorized a person to sign the necessary documents.
Ensure shareholder information and folio number or DP ID - Client ID are available on the website.
watch: Shares shall not be transferred if the beneficial owner encashed any dividend warrant or had a dividend amount credited to their bank account during the last seven years.
